name: Koumi (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Koumi town emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised character, surrounded by three outlined triangles.
history: Municipal flag of Koumi, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1961.

features.role: Koumi town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised character, surrounded by three outlined triangles
